maradona-hand.line: The Hand of God: a leap with the keeper, and a fist nobody in charge seemed to see.

maradona-solo.line: Four minutes after the Hand of God, a run from deep through half the England team. The Goal of the Century.

pele-1970.line: A towering header to open the scoring in the final.

carlos-alberto-1970.line: The captain arrives at full pace to finish the team goal of all team goals, laid off by Pelé.

bale-overhead-2018.line: Moments after coming off the bench, a bicycle kick to put Madrid ahead in the final.

bale-strike-2018.line: A speculative strike that squirmed through Karius's hands to settle the final.

messi-header-2009.line: A rare header, looping over Van der Sar, to seal the final in Rome.

gerrard-istanbul.line: The captain's header that started the comeback from 3–0 down at half-time.

smicer-istanbul.line: Two minutes after the first, a low drive past Dida: 3–2, and the comeback is on.

ramos-lisbon.line: A header from a corner in stoppage time, with Atlético a minute from the trophy.

messi-wembley-2011.line: A drive past Van der Sar to retake the lead in the final at Wembley.

drogba-munich.line: A header from a corner, two minutes from defeat, in Bayern's own stadium.

robben-wembley.line: The late winner in an all-German final, after a backheel from Ribéry.

bellingham-slovakia.line: An overhead kick in the fifth minute of stoppage time, with England a minute from going out.

yamal-france.line: A curler from a 16-year-old to equalise in the semi-final.

watkins-netherlands.line: Off the bench, a turn and a low finish in the last minute to reach the final.

saka-switzerland.line: A shuffle onto the stronger foot and a curler to equalise in the quarter-final.

schick-scotland.line: A lob over a keeper caught off the line: the goal of the tournament.

shaw-final.line: A first international goal, in the second minute of the final.

pavard-argentina.line: A half-volley that swerved and dipped: the goal of the tournament.

trippier-croatia.line: A free kick in the fifth minute of a World Cup semi-final.

ronaldo-spain.line: A free kick two minutes from time to complete a hat-trick against Spain.

vardy-manutd.line: A goal in an 11th Premier League game in a row: a record.

vardy-liverpool.line: A volley on the run over Mignolet, in the season Leicester won the league.

ronaldinho-bernabeu.line: A solo goal so good the Bernabéu stood to applaud.

messi-bernabeu-2017.line: The stoppage-time winner, then the shirt held up to the Bernabéu.

richarlison-serbia.line: A flick up and a scissor kick: the goal of the tournament.

aldawsari-argentina.line: A twist and a curler to complete the biggest upset of the tournament.

enzo-mexico.line: A curler to make it 2–0 and settle Argentina's nerves.

messi-mexico.line: A low drive to break the deadlock with Argentina's tournament on the line.

dimaria-final-2022.line: The finish to a sweeping counter-attack: 2–0 in the final.

mbappe-volley-final.line: A volley 97 seconds after the first, to make it 2–2.

henry-manutd-2004.line: A turn and a dipping strike past Howard.

henry-liverpool-2004.line: A slalom through the Liverpool defence on the day the season was saved.

pires-anfield-2003.line: A curler at Anfield to win it.

edu-chelsea-2003.line: A deflected free kick, early on, against the new-money Chelsea.

vieira-spurs-2004.line: The opener at White Hart Lane, on the day the title was won.

vieira-leicester-2004.line: The winner on the final day, completing a season unbeaten.

russo-backheel.line: A backheel through the keeper's legs in the semi-final.

toone-final.line: Off the bench in the final, a lob over the keeper.

kelly-final.line: A scramble from a corner in extra time, then a shirt swung overhead: the winner.

stanway-spain.line: A drive in extra time to win the quarter-final.

james-china.line: A curler, one of two goals in a 6–1 win.

agyemang-italy.line: A teenager off the bench, equalising in stoppage time of the semi-final.
